annotations.text: Long-press any card — collapsed or expanded. Two steps instead of four, and no need to expand a card to remove it. Matches the exercise tab in the live workout and the rows in the templates list: actions first, section break, destructive last.
Same shape as the live workout's Delete Exercise alert, which is the only other place an exercise gets removed. Message names the exercise and its set count.
The existing More button, untouched — it opens the same menu, so both paths lead to one place. Nothing here changes except the last item's wording.
